name: cameron-house
description: Cameron's house dev process: the automatic checks and commands that should apply in every repo, on every machine, and in cloud sessions.

plugins.name: house
plugins.description: House dev process: syntax gate on every write, git and merge gates, a block on shell-spliced code edits, a report when a test or CI check is weakened, deny-path scoping for recursive sweeps, owner-scoped auto-approval of the git write flow, session orientation, an end-of-session check that something was actually run, the ship/since/repo-doctor commands, and an isolated Playwright browser.
